pr_title: Remove duplication of methods' code of class `Window` using an alias
pr_body:
- Fixes #82936.
- Closes #83014.

This PR is an alternative fix to the issue linked above; what it does is it makes the `Window::move_to_foreground()` method an alias for the `Window::grab_focus()` method.

**Note**: I tried many different ways of making an alias in C++ - this version compiles, but I'm not sure if this is the best approach: ideally we'd like a situation where calling one method is internally a call of the other one.

Any suggestions for improvements are welcome.
pr_comments: Let's go with https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/83014 then, sorry for having you make a redundant PR, I wasn't sure which approach would be best.
No worries, I created this one mainly to make it easier to make a decision, having both options to compare side by side :)

issue_context.title: Duplicated Code in Window::move_to_foreground() and Window::grab_focus()
comments: I assume the correct solution would be to keep one of them and change all calls to the other method to the one kept; this leaves the question of which of these methods' name is a better fit for what it does - I believe `grab_focus()` to be the better one.
I did some quick code clone detection , I should point out that duplicate code is not rare, maybe we can do something about it.
